Protect Arborstone from the attacking Wardens.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Protect [[Arborstone (explorable area)|Arborstone]] from the [[warden]]s. You have 4 groups remaining.

===Reward===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 750 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 250 [[Gold]]
* [[Equipment Requisition]]

== Walkthrough ==
Follow the quest indicator a short distance to find [[Terrik zu Heltzer]]. He will be set upon by four groups of two level 24 Wardens, although he does not need to survive to complete the quest. 

As long as you do not get mobbed, the quest should be simple to complete successfully. Watch out for the [[Warden of Earth|Wardens of Earth]], who can cause considerable damage and can [[knock down|knock you down]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;[[Rutger zu Heltzer]]
:''"Your earlier heroics enabled us to reestablish our hold on Arborstone, the sacred cathedral of the zu Heltzers. Within its depths are great stores of magical amber. Unfortunately, as a side effect the wardens have been drawn to the area in droves...and our defenses have been overrun! My nephew, Terrik, has been trapped inside. He is a talented stone singer, able to control and construct magical protectors, and I sent him in to summon stone guardians to help fend off the wardens. But despite his talents, I fear that he alone cannot win this fight. Please, help '''Terrik zu Heltzer''' and the '''[[zu Heltzer Guardian]]s''' defend '''Arborstone''' at all costs."''
